The lesion is largely nonenhancing by ET Volume (mL), Enhancement Quality, and n_components_enhancing, which is also more typical of IDH-mutant glioma than IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Cortical involvement and a temporal/insula component in Tumor Location are compatible with an IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. Against IDH mutation, age_years of 45 is not very young, and the large Total tumor volume (mL), midline_shift_present with max_shift_mm, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, Deep WM invasion, and high Proportion Necrosis are more aggressive features that can be seen in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Overall, the specific T2-FLAIR mismatch and minimal enhancement outweigh the aggressive but less specific features, so the conclusion is IDH-mutant.
